card.name: Spots just before a dose number or mutation
card.fires_on: The space or small word right before a number in HIV-drug text, such as before a dose like 50 mg, or the letter I in a list of resistance mutations. Also seen after 'methods of' before 'social networks'.

modes.label: Before a dose amount
modes.description: The blank space right before a milligram amount after 'dose of' or 'dose to' in antiretroviral drug text.

modes.label: Repeated mutation letter
modes.description: The letter I starting a repeated amino-acid substitution in a list of resistance mutations.

modes.label: Before social networks
modes.description: The word 'of' just before 'social networks' in a passage on social network theory.
